title: SCALPSS image filename
reference: BGM1 SCALPSS Payload Data Archive User Guide (SCALPSS archive SIS), §4 (Data Guide, Fig. 3) and §4.1 (Bundle Structure)

segments.label: Capture number
segments.description: Sequential capture index, starting at 0. A capture is one period from when a set of cameras (SFL or LFL) was powered on to when it was powered off; SFL and LFL captures are numbered independently, so equal numbers across the two sets are unrelated. BGM1 has SFL captures 0–165 (transit 0–4, descent 5, surface 6–165; 64 was never downlinked) and LFL captures 0–4 (transit 0–3, descent 4). The label calls this the observation ID.

segments.label: Frame number
segments.description: Zero-indexed frame within the capture; frames viewed in order form a video. Frames sharing a number within one capture and camera set form a stereo group. Surface HDR captures keep only the last four bracketed frames, so their first frame is 14, 15 or 16.

segments.label: Camera
segments.description: Which of the six Chameleon 3 cameras produced the image. LFL cameras (50 mm lenses) imaged the descent from 50 m to 5.5 m AGL at 10 fps; SFL cameras imaged the descent from 30 m AGL to touchdown + 10 s at 8 fps and continued with HDR captures through the surface mission.

SFL0.description: Wide-angle SFL camera pointed about +110° from the lander +y axis; views terrain beneath all four RCS thruster pairs. Stereo partner of SFL1.

SFL1.description: Wide-angle SFL camera pointed about −110° from the lander +y axis; views terrain beneath all four RCS thruster pairs. Stereo partner of SFL0.

SFL2.description: SFL camera pointed about +60° from the lander +y axis; views the ground beneath one RCS thruster pair. Stereo partner of SFL3.

SFL3.description: SFL camera pointed about −60° from the lander +y axis; views the ground beneath one RCS thruster pair. Stereo partner of SFL2.

LFL0.description: Descent-only camera with optimal stereo overlap beneath one RCS thruster pair at about 8 m altitude. Stereo partner of LFL1.

LFL1.description: Descent-only camera with optimal stereo overlap beneath one RCS thruster pair at about 8 m altitude. Stereo partner of LFL0.

segments.label: Image type
segments.description: Which of the four onboard renditions of the same frame this is. Every type was JPEG-compressed (lossy) on the payload.

LOW_FOV.description: Cropped window of the full frame, JPEG quality 90. Crop {x, y, width, height} in pixels: SFL0 {1634, 269, 256, 192}, SFL1 {1046, 1330, 256, 192}, SFL2 {451, 0, 512, 96}, SFL3 {517, 1155, 256, 192}, LFL0/LFL1 {895, 671, 256, 192}.

segments.label: Extension
segments.description: File format. TIFFs (data_raw) are decompressed copies of the original JPEGs (browse_raw) and carry no additional resolution.

values.TIF: Decompressed TIFF of the downlinked JPEG (data_raw)
values.JPG: Original JPEG as received during the mission (browse_raw)
values.TIF.XML: Full PDS4 label with all image metadata (data_raw)
values.JPG.XML: PDS4 browse label with identifying information only (browse_raw)
